title: Unit partnerships and fit across board contexts

cases.title: Morgana’s carry partner
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: Is Ahri actually Morgana’s best carry partner, or do Morgana boards do just as well with Sivir?
cases.question: Is Ahri actually Morgana’s best carry partner, or do Morgana boards do just as well with Sivir?
cases.scenario: Morgana end states with an itemized Ahri versus itemized Sivir partner; declare Morgana and partner star/loadout strata, and keep dual-partner boards separate.
cases.plan: Discover Morgana loadouts and recurring partners, then compare explicit partner investment cohorts in shared final-level and named frontline shells. Use query_cohort to show Invoker/Hunter support, holder builds and total-item/board-size distributions.
cases.checks: Report partner-specific joint counts, mean/top4/win and uncertainty. Make AP-versus-AD inventory differences visible instead of assuming identical items transfer. Three-star and dual-carry variants are separate; pooled Morgana statistics cannot identify a partner winner.
cases.limits: Exact board size and budget are groupable but not shared-filter fields. Comparisons describe final states rather than a causal replacement of Ahri with Sivir.

cases.title: Mama Beak beside Aphelios
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: Which Aphelios boards actually do well with Mama Beak, and which do better without her?
cases.question: Which Aphelios boards actually do well with Mama Beak, and which do better without her?
cases.scenario: Itemized Aphelios boards, Mama Beak present versus absent; split Mama Beak zero/partial/three-item and star strata, including three-star.
cases.plan: Use compare_cohorts with Mama Beak target and omitted baseline inside a shared Aphelios build/star/core shell, then inspect itemized variants. get_cohort_unit_deltas/query_cohort discovers real absent-group alternative anchors through explicit named-absence predicates. Verify Summoner/Riftbeast contexts by trait data.
cases.checks: Report the inclusion association inside several supported Aphelios contexts, not Mama Beak's all-board average. State the absent cohort's actual observed substitutes and investment distributions; distinguish utility from itemized carry proxies.
cases.limits: The complement is all otherwise eligible boards without the target, not one forced replacement. Alpha Mark, emergency selection and item-transfer histories are not observed.

cases.title: Kennen as Draven’s second damage source
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: On finished Draven boards, when does giving Kennen the secondary damage items work better than leaving them on Gnar or Ezreal?
cases.question: On finished Draven boards, when does giving Kennen the secondary damage items work better than leaving them on Gnar or Ezreal?
cases.scenario: Fixed Draven star/build strata with secondary damage equipment concentrated on Kennen, Gnar or Ezreal. Use observed shared named inventories where supported.
cases.plan: Discover candidate holder loadouts in Draven cohorts, define investment with exact items and stars, then compare joint allocations in shared Draven/frontline/level conditions. Keep naked other candidates distinct from itemized ones and inspect actual trait packages.
cases.checks: Preserve Draven's build and show candidate stars, allocated items and sample/outcome tradeoffs. Do not compare optimized unlike inventories as a same-inventory swap. Gloves, artifacts and emblem packages remain distinct exact builds.
cases.limits: No automatic classification of damage items or boardwide equal budget. Final items do not establish removers, availability or when an allocation changed.

cases.title: Fiddlesticks’ frontline partner
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: For finished Spellweaver boards with Fiddlesticks tanking, does adding another Defender actually outperform using that slot for another carry or support?
cases.question: For finished Spellweaver boards with Fiddlesticks tanking, does adding another Defender actually outperform using that slot for another carry or support?
cases.scenario: Spellweaver boards with Fiddlesticks in a declared tank-item role. Discover actual additional Defenders and non-Defender alternatives at common final levels and carry investment.
cases.plan: Use unit/trait/loadout discovery before selecting candidates; confirm joint Fiddlesticks, main carry and support predicates. compare_cohorts contrasts named extra-Defender versus named alternative packages while querying resulting contribution counts and same-board supports.
cases.checks: Do not choose a non-Defender comparator from memory or treat a pooled trait ranking as the slot decision. Report support and outcomes for actual packages, how their breakpoints differ, and exact Fiddlesticks/carry investment.
cases.limits: Tank role is a declared loadout proxy; no damage absorbed field. Same level does not certify one-for-one deployed-slot equality. Complete roster verification is a separate grouped/prepared constraint.

cases.title: Taric versus Amumu beside Draven
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: In finished Draven boards, is two-star Taric still better than two-star Amumu when Taric has no Vanguard active but Amumu has Juggernaut?
cases.question: In finished Draven boards, is two-star Taric still better than two-star Amumu when Taric has no Vanguard active but Amumu has Juggernaut?
cases.scenario: Finished Draven boards with Taric2 without active Vanguard versus Amumu2 with active Juggernaut; separate boards containing both tanks.
cases.plan: Define common Draven stars/build and named tank item packages. Use a complement of active Vanguard inside the Taric shell to cover missing trait rows, while explicit Amumu/Juggernaut predicates describe the other package. Compare reportable returned package summaries descriptively; full direct head-to-head needs a certified Taric-without-Vanguard population or enumerated valid negative conditions.
cases.checks: Preserve tank stars and asymmetrical trait requirements. Report actual companion frontliners, samples and mean/top4/win; do not mistake active:false for missing-trait inclusion. Package-level differences must not be assigned solely to tank identity.
cases.limits: The DSL cannot nest a complement within a new explicit cohort. No linked target, position, targeting history or complete automatic matching is available; absence route and its limitations must be explicit.

cases.title: Where Sett works as the main tank
cases.subject: units
cases.original_question: Which finished carry cores actually perform well with Sett as the main tank, and does that hold without a Ravager emblem on him?
cases.question: Which finished carry cores actually perform well with Sett as the main tank, and does that hold without a Ravager emblem on him?
cases.scenario: Sett2 as a declared main-tank investment proxy, with and without Ravager Emblem, across discovered itemized carry cores.
cases.plan: Discover Sett's exact defensive loadouts and companion stars/item counts. Define named carry-core cohorts independently of the emblem, compare bound-emblem versus ordinary Sett builds within each, and test actual alternative named tanks where support exists.
cases.checks: Give core-specific support/outcomes and emblem-free observations, not Sett's marginal top4. State the tank-role criterion and actual builds. Avoid declaring a family universally good from one frequent unit row.
cases.limits: No generic main-tank or six-trait-family classifier; core recurrence requires conjunction checks. Damage absorbed, survival and why Sett was chosen are unobserved.
